parsed.post: Discarding the recent run (0.9968) as it regressed from my best (0.9865). It seems the combination of LR 0.04 and WD 0.1 might be sensitive to initialization or batch dynamics. I'll try a more moderate WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.05 to balance regularization and capacity.
parsed.description: Testing a middle-ground WEIGHT_DECAY of 0.05 to find a more stable regularization point between 0.01 and 0.1 for the depth-6, AR-64, LR-0.04 configuration.
